import MumfordLib.ExteriorPowerDuality

/-!
# Exterior cohomology and alternating forms

This module packages the final linear-algebra transport used by the analytic
torus calculation. A degree-one comparison with the dual of a finite free
lattice, together with the exterior cup equivalence, gives alternating forms.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {R H₁ Hₙ L : Type*} [CommRing R]
  [AddCommGroup H₁] [Module R H₁]
  [AddCommGroup Hₙ] [Module R Hₙ]
  [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L]
  [Module.Free R L] [Module.Finite R L]

private noncomputable def exteriorPowerMapEquiv
    (degreeOneDual : H₁ ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R L) (n : ℕ) :
    (⋀[R]^n H₁) ≃ₗ[R] (⋀[R]^n (Module.Dual R L)) :=
  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (exteriorPower.map n degreeOneDual.toLinearMap) ⟨
    exteriorPower.map_injective degreeOneDual.symm.toLinearMap (by
      ext x
      simp),
    exteriorPower.map_surjective degreeOneDual.surjective⟩

/-- Transport an exterior cup equivalence through a degree-one duality to
obtain alternating forms on the lattice. -/
  def exteriorCohomologyAlternatingEquiv
    (degreeOneDual : H₁ ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R L)
    (n : ℕ) (cup : (⋀[R]^n (H₁)) ≃ₗ[R] Hₙ) :
    Hₙ ≃ₗ[R] AlternatingMap R L R (Fin n) :=
  (cup.symm.trans (exteriorPowerMapEquiv degreeOneDual n)).trans
    (exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv R L n)

@[simp]
theorem exteriorCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_apply
    (degreeOneDual : H₁ ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R L)
    (n : ℕ) (cup : (⋀[R]^n (H₁)) ≃ₗ[R] Hₙ)
    (x : Hₙ) (v : Fin n → L) :
    exteriorCohomologyAlternatingEquiv degreeOneDual n cup x v =
      exteriorPower.pairingDual R L n
        (exteriorPower.map n degreeOneDual.toLinearMap (cup.symm x))
        (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v) := by
  rw [exteriorCohomologyAlternatingEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    LinearEquiv.trans_apply, exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv_apply]
  rfl

/-- An exterior cup of degree-one classes evaluates as the determinant of
their values on the lattice. -/
@[simp]
theorem exteriorCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_apply_cup_ιMulti
    (degreeOneDual : H₁ ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R L)
    (n : ℕ) (cup : (⋀[R]^n H₁) ≃ₗ[R] Hₙ)
    (c : Fin n → H₁) (v : Fin n → L) :
    exteriorCohomologyAlternatingEquiv degreeOneDual n cup
        (cup (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n c)) v =
      Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i j => degreeOneDual (c j) (v i))) := by
  change exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv R L n
    (exteriorPower.map n degreeOneDual.toLinearMap
      (cup.symm (cup (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n c)))) v = _
  rw [cup.symm_apply_apply, exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti]
  exact exteriorPowerDualAlternatingEquiv_ιMulti R L n _ v

end Mumford.Analytic
